answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that grows only through completed, peer-verified jobs, so creating a fake identity is cheap but making it trusted is expensive. Like crossing a canyon, a sybil must pay the full cost for each copy — stake, time, and a public work history — while honest agents reuse one established record. A newcomer may look smooth as velvet at first, yet without that history its transactions stay capped and escrowed, and juniper-like roots of past performance let others check whether an identity is real or just another disposable clone.
